name: Sorn
priceTHB: Tasting menu ฿7,800++ per person (+10% service +7% VAT ≈ ฿9,180 net, per TableCheck); special collab menus ฿8,900–20,000
bookingMethod: Online via TableCheck — reservations open 12:00 noon Bangkok time on the 25th of each month for the following month (24th if the 25th is a Saturday). International guests may instead email reservation@sornfinesouthern.com from 00:00 Bangkok time on the 15th. Phone +66 99 081 1119.
bookingNotes: Fully prepaid and strictly non-refundable — no rescheduling or cancellation allowed; reservation voided if you arrive more than 30 minutes late. Cannot accommodate shellfish allergies or vegetarian/vegan diets. Corkage requires buying one bottle from their list per bottle brought. Parking at Four Wings Hotel (฿50/hr) with free shuttle.
hours: Dinner only, from 18:00; official Instagram bio lists service Sun–Fri evenings (closed Sat) — confirm exact seatings on TableCheck
zone: Sukhumvit 26 / Phrom Phong
signature: 20+ small-course Southern Thai tasting
Southern crab curry
facts: Chef-owner Supaksorn 'Ice' Jongsiri's Southern Thai fine-dining restaurant at 56 Sukhumvit 26 (Soi Ari), opened 2018. Thailand's first restaurant to reach three MICHELIN stars (2025 guide), retained in the 2026 guide. Only ~22 seats, which is why bookings are a monthly race.
queueTips: No walk-ins, ever — ~22 seats. Set two alarms: email window opens the 15th at midnight Bangkok time (international guests), TableCheck opens the 25th at 12:00 noon Bangkok time. Full prepayment, zero refunds, and arrive within 30 minutes of your slot or lose it.

name: Sühring
priceTHB: Tasting menu ฿7,800 (shorter) / ฿9,800 (extended, ~7 courses); wine pairings ฿5,800–9,800; supplements e.g. white-truffle Spätzle ฿2,400 (Dec 2025 diner report)
bookingMethod: Online via SevenRooms, up to 60 days in advance (official site); or phone +66 2 107 2777 / email reservation@restaurantsuhring.com
bookingNotes: Restaurant recommends booking at least 1 month ahead; no-show or cancellation within 48 hours may incur ฿5,800/person fee. After the November 2025 three-star promotion, weekend slots reportedly disappear within minutes of the 60-day window opening.
dressCode: Smart casual — official site asks men for trousers and appropriate footwear; dressing up encouraged
hours: Dinner from ~17:30–18:00; lunch Thu–Sun 12:30–14:30; closed Mon (some listings also show Tue closed) — confirm on SevenRooms
station: BTS Chong Nonsi / MRT Lumphini (both ~2 km — take a taxi)
zone: Yen Akat / Sathorn (residential lane, Yannawa)
signature: Wildpastete (game pâté en croûte)
Spätzle with white Alba truffle
Black Forest cake reinterpretation
facts: Run by German twin brothers Thomas and Mathias Sühring in a restored 1970s villa at 10 Yen Akat Soi 3, opened 2016. Promoted to three MICHELIN stars in the Thailand 2026 guide (announced Nov 2025) — the first German restaurant in Asia to hold three stars. Ranked No.18 on Asia's 50 Best 2026.
queueTips: Book the moment the 60-day SevenRooms window opens — weekend tables go in minutes since the third star. Weeknight lunch (Thu–Sun) is the easier way in. It's in a residential lane with no rail access; budget a 10-min taxi from Sathorn.

name: Baan Tepa
priceTHB: 7-course tasting ฿6,200++ (฿7,298 net incl. service + VAT, per TableCheck); July–Aug 2026 pop-up dinner ฿4,500++ (฿5,297 net)
bookingMethod: Currently closed for renovation — reopening reservations to be announced. Pop-up (Jul 22–Aug 2, 2026 at F.V Sukhumvit 39) books via LINE OA @BAANTEPA or WhatsApp +66 98 696 9074. Regular-era bookings run on TableCheck with a 60-day window; solo diners by email reservation@baantepabkk.com.
bookingNotes: TEMPORARILY CLOSED for renovation: last service 2 May 2026, reopening ~26 August 2026 (official website/Facebook). Regular policies: dinner Wed–Sun, seatings 18:00/19:00/20:00; cannot accommodate vegetarian/vegan/dairy-free/gluten-free; children 12+; private Garden Wing ฿5,500/person minimum.
hours: (pre-closure) Dinner Wed–Sun, seatings 18:00 / 19:00 / 20:00; closed Mon–Tue — reopens ~26 Aug 2026
zone: Ramkhamhaeng / Bang Kapi (east Bangkok — taxi territory)
signature: White Lotus (kaleidoscope of intricately cut vegetables — jicama, lotus root, enoki)
facts: Chef Chudaree 'Tam' Debhakam — Top Chef Thailand winner and former Blue Hill at Stone Barns sous chef — runs this two-MICHELIN-star restaurant in her family's converted home on Ramkhamhaeng Road. Holds a MICHELIN Green Star for sustainability, anchored by its own Tepa Garden growing heritage vegetables and herbs. Temporarily closed for renovation until ~26 Aug 2026, with a 'Past • Present • Future' pop-up at F.V Sukhumvit 39 (Jul 22–Aug 2, 2026).
queueTips: Don't plan a visit before late August 2026 — the house is closed for renovation. The only way to taste Chef Tam's food this summer is the F.V Sukhumvit 39 pop-up (Jul 22–Aug 2, two sittings 17:00/20:00, Wed–Sun) via LINE @BAANTEPA. Follow @baantepabkk for reopening reservation dates.

name: Chef's Table
priceTHB: 7-course signature menu ฿9,200++ (+10% service +7% VAT); 7-glass wine pairing ฿8,800++ (official menu page, Feb 2026)
bookingMethod: Online via TableCheck (lebua's booking system); or phone +66 2 624 9555 / WhatsApp +66 61 406 9999
bookingNotes: In the Tower Club at lebua, State Tower — allow extra time for the lobby and lift up to the 61st floor. Dress code is actively stated by the hotel. Wine-pairing upgrades offered (Château Pavie ฿3,000++, Château d'Yquem ฿4,000++).
dressCode: Smart elegant — men need collared shirts and long trousers; no T-shirts, sleeveless tops, shorts, or caps (official)
zone: Silom / Bang Rak riverside (State Tower, 61st floor)
facts: Two-MICHELIN-star contemporary French restaurant on the 61st floor of lebua at State Tower (1055 Silom Rd), retained in the 2026 guide. Executive Chef Vincent Thierry cooks seven courses in an open kitchen built around a Molteni stove encased in Carrara marble, with Bangkok skyline views.
queueTips: Noticeably easier to book than Sorn or Sühring — TableCheck usually shows availability days-to-weeks out, not months. The dress code is the practical trap: no shorts or sneakers-with-shorts looks; men must wear collared shirts and long trousers or risk being turned away at the Tower Club.

name: Côte by Mauro Colagreco
priceTHB: Carte Blanche 9-course ~฿7,800 per person; 4-course Escapade lunch ~฿3,300 (Time Out); prices +10% service +7% VAT — lunch pricing has varied by season, so re-check when booking
bookingMethod: Online via SevenRooms, or through Capella Bangkok hotel reservations
bookingNotes: Inside Capella Bangkok on Charoenkrung Road (riverside). Menus change daily. Closed Mon–Tue. The 4-course lunch is the accessible entry point to a two-star kitchen.
hours: Lunch Wed–Sun 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30); dinner Wed–Sun 18:00–22:00; closed Mon–Tue
zone: Charoenkrung riverside (Capella Bangkok)
facts: Riviera-inspired restaurant of Argentinian chef Mauro Colagreco (of Mirazur, the three-star former World's No.1), open at Capella Bangkok since 2020. Executive chef Davide Garavaglia, a Mirazur alum since 2015, runs the kitchen. Promoted to two MICHELIN stars in the 2025 guide and retained for 2026; menus reimagine classic Riviera dishes with daily-changing produce and Chao Phraya river views.
queueTips: Book the Escapade lunch (Wed–Sun) for the same two-star kitchen at less than half the dinner price — Time Out called it Bangkok's best fine-dining lunch. Dinner books out on weekends but is far less brutal than Sorn/Sühring. From BTS Saphan Taksin it's a 10–15 min riverside walk or short taxi to Capella.

name: Gaa
zone: Thonglor (Sukhumvit 53)
priceTHB: Gaa Experience ฿6,200++ from 1 Jul 2026 (vegetarian ฿5,200++); weekend afternoon tea ฿1,800; kids menu (7+) ฿2,000
hours: Dinner daily from 17:30; lunch + afternoon tea Sat–Sun from 12:00
bookingMethod: TableCheck (online, prepaid)
bookingNotes: Free cancellation up to 48h before (24h for afternoon tea); no-show charged full menu price; dietary requests need 24h notice; corkage ฿3,000/bottle (waived if buying from their cellar). Note the standard menu price rises ฿5,200→฿6,200++ on 1 Jul 2026.
dressCode: No strict dress code — 'dress appropriately' requested
signature: Charcoal-grilled 'Tandoori Story' durian with roti
Unripe jackfruit with pickles and roti
Vegetarian tasting menu
facts: Opened 2017 by chef Garima Arora (ex-Noma, ex-Gaggan), the first Indian woman to earn a MICHELIN star (2018, within a year of opening). Second star awarded in the 2024 guide, retained in 2026. Moved from its original Langsuan home to a renovated Thai house at 46/1 Sukhumvit 53 in 2021. Arora won the MICHELIN Guide Thailand Young Chef Award 2022.
queueTips: Reservation-only tasting menu — book via TableCheck; walk-ins not realistic

name: Anne-Sophie Pic at Le Normandie
zone: Riverside (Bang Rak, Mandarin Oriental)
priceTHB: 3-course lunch ฿4,500++; 7-course 'Voyage' dinner ฿9,000++ (à la carte also offered, min 3 dishes/person)
hours: Wed–Sun: lunch 12:00–15:30 (last order 13:30), dinner 18:30–23:30 (last order 21:00); seasonal closure 6–28 Jul 2026
bookingMethod: SevenRooms (via Mandarin Oriental site)
bookingNotes: 48h cancellation policy — penalty ฿2,250/person (lunch) or ฿4,500/person (dinner); groups of 6+ must contact the hotel directly (+66 2 659 9000, mobkk-normandie@mohg.com); dietary requests need 48h notice.
dressCode: Elegant attire; jacket mandatory for men at dinner (loaner jackets available); no sleeveless shirts for men
signature: Berlingots (Pic's signature filled pasta)
Lobster dashi with red fruits
facts: Thailand's first French fine-dining restaurant, open since 1958 atop the Mandarin Oriental's tower wing on the Chao Phraya. Relaunched September 2025 under Anne-Sophie Pic, the world's most Michelin-starred female chef, with interiors by Humbert & Poyet; promoted from 1 to 2 stars in the MICHELIN Guide Thailand 2026.
queueTips: Closed annually for maintenance — in 2026 that's 6–28 July; plan around it. Hotel guests can arrive via the Oriental Pier boat rather than BTS.

name: INDDEE
zone: Langsuan / Chit Lom (Lumphini)
priceTHB: 8-Destination Journey ฿4,200++; 10-Destination Journey ฿4,900++ (vegetable version ฿4,200++) — prices from the Jul 2025 menu relaunch; Michelin lists the all-in band at ฿5,000–9,999
bookingMethod: SevenRooms (via inddeebkk.com/reservations)
bookingNotes: Also bookable by phone +66 62 812 9696 or reservations@inddeebkk.com; chef's table and private spaces across two floors of the townhouse.
signature: 10-Destination Journey across India's regions
Award-winning wine pairing (No.1 wine program in Asia, Star Wine List)
facts: Modern Indian tasting-menu restaurant in a restored 100-year-old townhouse off Soi Langsuan, led by head chef Sachin Poojary (ex-Chef de Cuisine at Wasabi by Morimoto, New York). Launched its evolved 'third chapter' menus on 31 Jul 2025 and was promoted from 1 to 2 MICHELIN stars in the Thailand 2026 guide. Wine program has won Star Wine List of the Year (2023) and a Wine Spectator award (2024).
queueTips: Tucked in an alley off Langsuan Road — allow a few extra minutes to find the entrance; parking available

name: Mezzaluna
zone: Riverside / Silom (lebua State Tower, 65F)
priceTHB: Chef's Tasting Menu: 7 courses ฿8,000++, 9 courses ฿9,600++ (++ = 10% service + 7% VAT); special event dinners ~฿12,000++
hours: Mon–Sat 17:30–00:30 (last booking 21:30, last order 21:45); closed Sundays
bookingMethod: TableCheck (deposit required)
bookingNotes: ฿3,000/person deposit, credited against the bill; free amendment/cancellation up to 72h before; children 7+ only; also via phone +66 2 624 9555, WhatsApp +66 61 406 9999 or dome@lebua.com.
dressCode: Smart elegant — men need collared shirts and long trousers; no T-shirts, sleeveless tops, shorts or caps
signature: Murakami wagyu beef from Niigata
French-Japanese seasonal tasting by chef Ryuki Kawasaki
facts: Crescent-shaped dining room on the 65th floor of State Tower with double-height windows over the Chao Phraya. Executive chef Ryuki Kawasaki cooks French cuisine with Japanese precision, featuring Murakami beef from his home prefecture Niigata. lebua states it has held 2 MICHELIN stars in every Thailand guide edition since the first (2018) — retained again in 2026.
queueTips: Last booking is 21:30 — earlier slots get sunset views over the river; arrive early to clear State Tower lobby security/lifts

name: R-Haan
zone: Thonglor (Soi Paidee Madee, between Sukhumvit 53 and Thonglor Soi 9)
priceTHB: Seasonal 'Samrub' set ฿5,212++ per person (recent 2025 reviews cite ฿5,212–5,512); wine pairing +฿3,512–3,812
hours: Dinner only, daily 18:00–23:00
bookingMethod: TableCheck (deposit required)
bookingNotes: Deposit required to secure the table; groups over 5 should contact the restaurant directly (095-141-5524, reservation@r-haan.com); private rooms for up to 6 and 18 guests; children 6+ only.
dressCode: Smart casual — men in long trousers and closed shoes; no sportswear, slippers or sleeveless shirts
signature: Seasonal Samrub — royal-Thai shared set (Summer/Rainy/Winter menus)
Traditional tom yum with king river prawn
facts: Royal-Thai fine dining co-founded by chef Chumpol Jangprai, built around the 'samrub' — the traditional Thai shared table — rotated across three seasonal menus (Summer, Rainy, Winter). Officially at 131 Soi Sukhumvit 53 (Paidee Madee) in Thonglor. Has held 2 MICHELIN stars in every guide from 2020 through 2026.
queueTips: Dinner only and reservation-driven — no walk-in queue; deep in the soi, so a short taxi/motorbike hop from BTS Thong Lo is easier than the ~15-min walk

priceTHB: Signature 14-course tasting ฿4,500++/person; wine pairing ฿2,800++ (5 glasses) or ฿3,200++ (7 glasses); ฿1,000+VAT deposit per person
bookingMethod: TableCheck
bookingNotes: Whole table must take the tasting menu; groups of 9+ book via WhatsApp; no children under 5; spice can be softened but shrimp paste/garlic/chili cannot be omitted. Last seating 20:30.
hours: Wed-Sun 18:00-23:00 (last seating 20:30); closed Mon-Tue
zone: Charoenkrung / Talat Noi
signature: Seasonal 14-course modern Thai tasting menu
Contemporary takes on Thai classics with Lao influences
Fermentation-driven desserts by pastry chef Saki Hoshino
facts: Run by chef-patron Napol 'Joe' Jantraget and pastry chef Saki Hoshino, who both spent about a decade cooking in Montreal before opening in Talat Noi. The name is the kitchen's sourcing ratio: roughly 80% Thai ingredients, 20% imported. Has held one Michelin star continuously across the 2020-2026 guides; Michelin cites its contemporary interpretations of Thai classics with Lao influences.
queueTips: Reservation-only; book weeks ahead for weekend dinner. A 10th-anniversary event was being sold on TableCheck for July 19, so the restaurant is very actively operating.

name: Akkee
priceTHB: Dinner set menu ฿3,850 (excl. add-ons); Thai craft beer & sato pairing (7 glasses) ฿1,550; a la carte also available
bookingMethod: Official website widget (eRestaurants)
bookingNotes: Book via the widget on akkeerestaurant.com/reservation, phone (+66) 82 561 4691, or LINE. Tasting menu has no seafood-free or vegan version. Located in Pak Kret, Nonthaburi — easiest by car/taxi.
hours: Dinner 17:30-23:00 (Mon-Tue, Thu-Fri); Sat-Sun lunch 12:00-15:00 + dinner 17:30-23:00; closed Wednesdays
station: MRT Pink Line Pak Kret Bypass (PK07)
zone: Pak Kret, Nonthaburi
signature: Rare 'lost recipe' Thai dishes recreated from old recipe books
Eastern-seaboard set menu: Gulf seafood and wild foraged herbs
Counter-style tasting with traditional charcoal/no-frills kitchen
facts: Chef-owner Sittikorn 'Ou' Chantop won the MICHELIN Young Chef Award when Akkee took its first star in the 2025 guide (retained 2026). The name means 'fire' in Thai; the kitchen uses only domestic Thai ingredients and rebuilds dishes from long-lost Thai recipe books. Michelin cites bold regional dishes with a rustic edge from traditional, no-frills preparation.
queueTips: Small tasting counter — reserve ahead, especially weekend lunch. PK07 station is on Chaeng Watthana Rd near the Pak Kret Bypass junction but the walking distance to the restaurant is unverified; a Grab/taxi is the practical option.

name: Aksorn
priceTHB: Tasting menu ฿4,150++/person (plus 10% service + 7% VAT); wine pairing ฿3,200; cancellation/no-show fee ฿2,075/person
bookingMethod: SevenRooms (linked from aksornbkk.com)
bookingNotes: Dinner only. Book via SevenRooms from the official site or call +66 2 116 8662. Cancellation/no-show fee of ฿2,075 per person applies.
hours: Daily 18:00-22:00 (dinner only)
zone: Charoenkrung / Bang Rak
signature: Rotating prix-fixe of dishes revived from vintage Thai cookbooks
Heritage mid-century Thai recipes (post-WWII era)
Open-kitchen dining room with rooftop bar
facts: Chef David Thompson's (ex-Nahm) heritage Thai restaurant, reviving rare dishes from his collection of vintage Thai cookbooks; the prix-fixe changes every few months. Sits on the 5th floor of Central: The Original Store — the 1950 site of the Chirathivat family's first Bangkok shop. One Michelin star, retained in the 2026 guide.
queueTips: No walk-in queue culture — reserve via SevenRooms; easier to get than most Bangkok stars but weekend slots go first. From BTS Saphan Taksin walk north along Charoenkrung ~10 min.

name: Avant
priceTHB: 9-course 'AVANT Experience' dinner ฿5,900++/person
bookingMethod: Chope
bookingNotes: Also bookable by phone +66 82 466 4962 or email reservation@restaurantavant.com. Roughly 10-seat chef's counter plus a private room (up to 10) — capacity is tiny, book well ahead.
hours: Mon-Sat 18:00-22:00; closed Sunday (some sources list Fri-Sat lunch 12:00-14:30 — confirm when booking)
zone: Langsuan / Soi Tonson (Pathumwan)
signature: Seafood-forward 9-course contemporary French tasting
Sashimi-grade Japanese seafood (~90% of the menu)
Counter dining with Chef Haikal presenting every dish
facts: Chef Haikal Johari, a Singaporean trained at L'Atelier de Joel Robuchon Tokyo and 3-star Amador, cooks contemporary French with Japanese and Asian sensibilities on the 30th floor of Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok. Paralysed after a 2015 motorcycle accident, he leads every service from the counter. Avant won its first Michelin star in the 2025 guide within about a year of opening and retained it in 2026. About 90% of the menu is seafood, mostly flown from Japan.
queueTips: No queue — it's a ~10-seat counter, so reserve as early as possible (weeks ahead); Chope shows live availability.

name: Blue by Alain Ducasse
priceTHB: Lunch set from ฿2,950++; dinner set menus roughly ฿4,900-7,500++ (signature 'Voyage' tasting at the top end) — menus rotate seasonally, confirm current pricing when booking
bookingMethod: SevenRooms
bookingNotes: Also via blue-alainducasse.com or +66 (0)6 5731 2346. Private rooms: Bronze Room (up to 6) and Pink Room (8-10). Vegan menus not offered; most other dietary needs accommodated.
hours: Lunch 12:00-13:30 and dinner 18:00-20:30 (last seating); no lunch service Tue (some listings also show no Wed lunch)
zone: ICONSIAM riverside (Khlong San)
signature: Menu Voyage signature tasting
Menu Decouverte
Contemporary French Riviera cooking with Chao Phraya River views
facts: Alain Ducasse's one-Michelin-star French fine-dining flagship in Thailand, on the 1st floor of ICONLUXE at ICONSIAM (Unit L101) overlooking the Chao Phraya. Currently led by executive chef Evens Lopez. Offers a 'Blue Journey' sunset river-cruise-plus-Voyage-menu package (฿50,000 for two). Star retained in the 2026 guide.
queueTips: Reservation-only; lunch 'Escale' set is the affordable entry point and easier to book. Gold Line Charoen Nakhon station connects directly to ICONSIAM; the ICONSIAM shuttle boat from Sathorn Pier is a scenic alternative.

name: Bo.lan
zone: Thong Lo (Sukhumvit 53), Watthana
priceTHB: Tasting menus ฿3,980 (Bo.lan Brief, 10 servings) / ฿4,600 (Balance, 13) / ฿4,800 (Feast, 15); TableCheck currently lists the chef's tasting at ฿4,800/person excl. taxes
hours: Thu–Sun 18:00–24:00 (dinner only, per Sep 2024 reopening coverage)
bookingMethod: TableCheck (prepaid) or phone 02-260-2962
bookingNotes: Full prepayment via TableCheck; cancellations within 48 hours or no-shows charged the full menu price; refunds lose 7% VAT; corkage ฿1,500++ (waived with one bottle from their cellar); advise allergies 24h ahead
queueTips: Reservation-only samrub dinners — no walk-in queue; small home-style dining room, so book well ahead for weekend seatings
signature: Samrub-style shared Thai set (soup, curry, relish, rice served together)
Rare regional produce from small Thai farmers
Bo.lan Feast 15-serving menu
facts: Founded by chefs Duangporn 'Bo' Songvisava and Dylan Jones; closed for three years and reopened September 2024 in a wooden house at 24 Sukhumvit Soi 53; regained a MICHELIN star as a NEW one-star in the Thailand 2026 guide; previously featured on Netflix's Chef's Table and ranked No.19 in Asia's 50 Best Restaurants 2019; cooking is samrub-style shared Thai rooted in time-honoured recipes and sustainability.

name: Cannubi by Umberto Bombana
zone: Silom / Rama IV (Dusit Thani Bangkok, L Floor)
station: MRT Si Lom (hotel has direct access); BTS Sala Daeng nearby
priceTHB: 7-course tasting ฿5,500++ (฿7,400++ with 3-glass wine pairing); set lunch and à la carte also offered; ++ = 10% service + 7% VAT
bookingMethod: TableCheck (Dusit Thani Bangkok), phone +66 2 200 9000, or email cannubi.dtbk@dusit.com
bookingNotes: Deposit ฿2,000 net/person (full prepayment on festive days); tables held max 15 minutes past reservation time; restaurant asks for bookings at least 3 hours ahead (24h for the Wine Bar)
queueTips: Hotel fine dining, reservation-driven — no queue; closed Mon–Tue, so weekend dinner slots go first
dressCode: Elegant attire — shorts, sandals and flip-flops not allowed
signature: Seasonal white-truffle menu (Bombana is 'The King of White Truffles')
7-course tasting menu
Set lunch
facts: Italian fine diner at Dusit Thani Bangkok by Umberto Bombana, chef of Hong Kong's 8½ Otto e Mezzo Bombana — the only three-MICHELIN-star Italian restaurant outside Italy — executed in Bangkok by his longtime protégé, Executive Italian Chef Andrea Susto; awarded one star in the MICHELIN Guide Thailand 2026, making it the first Italian restaurant in Thailand ever to hold a star.

name: Chim by Siam Wisdom
zone: Dusit / Samsen (Soi Ongkarak 13, off Samsen 28)
priceTHB: Rattanakosin Winter set (Nov 2025–Feb 2026): lunch set ฿3,250++, full tasting set ฿4,250++ (10% service + 7% VAT); menus change seasonally
bookingMethod: Chope (via official site), phone +66-61-647-6362, or email booking.chim@gmail.com
bookingNotes: ฿1,000 deposit required to confirm reservations; reservation-only fine dining
queueTips: New Dusit location is not near any BTS/MRT — plan a taxi/Grab (about 10–15 min from Victory Monument or Bang Sue side)
signature: Seasonal regional tasting journeys (e.g. HeManTaWaYo winter menu, north-to-south Thailand)
Rattanakosin-era royal Thai recipes
Lunch set at a lower price point
facts: Chef Thanintorn 'Noom' Chantharawan's Thai fine diner has held a MICHELIN star every year since 2018 (originally as Siam Wisdom); it has relocated from Sukhumvit 31 to a house at 315 Soi Ongkarak 13 (Samsen 28), Dusit; cooking revives Rattanakosin-period Thai cuisine through seasonal set menus.

name: Coda
zone: Lower Witthayu / Sindhorn Village (entrances on Witthayu Rd and Soi Ton Son), Lumphini, Pathum Wan
priceTHB: Seasonal tasting menu ฿3,490++/person (Aug 2025); prices exclude tax and 10% service; deposit ฿1,500 net/person applied to the bill
hours: Mon–Thu dinner 18:00–23:00; Fri–Sun lunch 12:30–15:30 and dinner 18:00–23:00
bookingMethod: TableCheck (also on Chope); phone +66 83 959 6296; LINE @codabangkok
bookingNotes: ฿1,500 net/person deposit, applied to final bill; refundable with 72+ hours notice (refunds within 15 business days), forfeited on no-show; online bookings up to 5 guests — larger groups contact directly
queueTips: Reservation-only; Sindhorn Village has two entrances (Witthayu Road and Tonson Alley) — MRT Lumphini is an alternative to BTS Ploen Chit, both around a 10–12 min walk
signature: Six-course seasonal contemporary Thai tasting menu
Seafood-leaning dishes rooted in the chef's family restaurant in Mahachai
facts: Contemporary Thai fine diner in Sindhorn Village by chef Supasit 'Tap' Kokpol, who cooked for over ten years in Australia and grew up around his mother's seafood restaurant in Mahachai (Samut Sakhon); won its first MICHELIN star in the 2025 guide and retained it in 2026; elegant two-storey, high-ceilinged dining room at 130-132 Witthayu Road.

name: etcha
zone: Ratchathewi (7F, Chatrium Grand Bangkok, 728 Phetchaburi Rd)
priceTHB: etcha 180 (8+ courses) ฿3,750; etcha 360 (11+ courses) ฿4,750; wine pairings ฿1,600 (3 glasses) / ฿2,500 (5) / ฿3,250 (6); plus 10% service + 7% VAT
hours: Tue–Sat from 18:00 (dinner only)
bookingMethod: SevenRooms via etchabkk.com; phone +66 2 126 7999; email etcha.cgb@chatrium.com; LINE lin.ee/1Kb1xww
bookingNotes: Full deposit taken at reservation; cancellations within 72 hours or no-shows forfeit the deposit; repeat guests can request course substitutions with advance notice
queueTips: Dinner-only, five nights a week and small — book ahead; closed Sun–Mon
signature: etcha 360 — 11+ course borderless tasting
etcha 180 — 8+ course tasting
European technique with Thai ingredients, golden cutlery and handmade pottery
facts: Chef Giacomo Primante's 'borderless dining' restaurant on the 7th floor of Chatrium Grand Bangkok combines European technique with Thai ingredients; earned its first MICHELIN star in the Thailand 2026 guide roughly eight months after opening in 2025 — one of the guide's NEW one-stars.

name: Maison Dunand
zone: Sathorn (Soi Sathon 10, Silom/Bang Rak)
priceTHB: Tasting menus: Sentier ฿2,950 / Alpage ฿4,950 / Sommet ฿6,500 net per person (menu valid through 19 Aug 2026)
hours: Dinner Tue-Sat 18:00-23:00; Lunch Fri-Sat 12:00-15:00; closed Sun-Mon
bookingMethod: Official website booking form or phone
bookingNotes: Restaurant manages its own reservations (website widget, +66 65 639 0515, or Reservations@maisondunand.com). Book ahead for Fri-Sat dinner and the Fri-Sat-only lunch service.
queueTips: No walk-in queue culture - this is a reservation restaurant. Friday/Saturday (the only lunch days) fill first; weeknight dinner is the easiest slot.
signature: Alpine tasting menus (French/Swiss/Italian Alps)
Cheese trolley with 20+ selections
Savoie- and Alsace-focused wine list
facts: Chef Arnaud Dunand Sauthier, formerly executive chef of the two-Michelin-star Le Normandie, cooks the food of his Savoie/Alpine heritage in a chalet-inspired house off Soi Sathon 10. One MICHELIN star (retained, Thailand 2026); inspectors cite the polished contemporary tasting menu, the 20+-cheese trolley and a wine collection strong on Alsace and Savoie.

name: Mia
zone: Sukhumvit 26 (Khlong Toei)
priceTHB: Weekend lunch 5-course ฿2,500; 6-course dinner ฿3,950; 8-course Taste of Mia ~฿6,900 net per person (Hungry Hub listing, Apr 2026); vegetarian 8-course ~฿5,900
hours: Dinner Fri-Tue 17:00-21:00; Lunch Sat-Sun 12:00-14:00; closed Wed-Thu
bookingMethod: SevenRooms online reservation
bookingNotes: SevenRooms link is published on the official site (miarestaurantbkk.com); also +66 98 862 9659 or reservation@miarestaurantbkk.com. Also sold as packages on Hungry Hub.
queueTips: Reservation-only fine dining; weekend dinner and the Sat-Sun lunch seatings book out first. Note the Wed-Thu closure when planning.
signature: Taste of Mia seasonal tasting menu
Savoury courses by chef Top, desserts by pastry chef Michelle
Full vegetarian and vegan tasting menus
facts: Chef duo Pongcharn 'Top' Russell and Michelle Goh run this one-MICHELIN-star (Thailand 2026) restaurant in a house on Soi Attha Kawi 1 off Sukhumvit 26 - modern European technique over Asian ingredients, with savoury courses by Top and desserts by Michelle. Dedicated vegetarian and vegan tasting menus run alongside the main menu.

name: Nahm
zone: Sathorn (COMO Metropolitan Bangkok, 27 South Sathorn Rd)
priceTHB: Set/degustation menu ~฿3,900 per person (recent diner reports); a la carte also available
hours: Dinner daily 18:00-22:00 (per COMO Hotels)
bookingMethod: OpenTable
bookingNotes: COMO's official page links to OpenTable (restref 30251); also bookable on Chope, by phone +66 2 625 3388 or WhatsApp +66 90 198 5413. Easier to book than most starred Thai rooms - hotel restaurant with nightly service.
queueTips: No queue - hotel fine dining. Same-week bookings are usually possible on OpenTable except peak season (Dec-Jan).
dressCode: Smart casual for dinner - no slippers, athletic wear or shorts (per Chope listing)
signature: Daily degustation menu of traditional Thai recipes
Bold old-school curries and relishes (nam prik)
Wine pairings with the degustation
facts: One MICHELIN star (Thailand 2026), held for many consecutive years. Since 2018 the kitchen is led by Bangkok-born chef Pim Techamuanvivit (also of Kin Khao, San Francisco), on the ground floor of COMO Metropolitan Bangkok. Strong, traditional central-Thai flavours built on close relationships with Thai producers.

name: Nawa
zone: Ekkamai (1F Park Lane, Sukhumvit 63)
priceTHB: Seasonal tasting menu ~฿3,800++ per person (recent Wongnai diner reviews); corkage ~฿1,000/bottle
hours: Dinner only Thu-Mon, two seatings at 17:45 and 20:30; closed Tue-Wed
bookingMethod: TableCheck
bookingNotes: Online reservations need at least 24h notice and open up to 60 days ahead; deposit taken. Full refund only if cancelled 7+ days out; changes to party size at least 72h ahead via info@nawathaicuisine.com. Also LINE @nawathaicuisine or +66 84 296 2442.
queueTips: Two fixed seatings per night and a small room - book the 17:45 seating for a more relaxed pace; weekends go first. Park Lane has parking, or it is about 400 m from BTS Ekkamai.
signature: Seasonal central-Thai tasting menu (changes twice a year)
Miang kham with fermented tea leaves
Grilled river prawn with tamarind relish
facts: One MICHELIN star (Thailand 2026). Run by chef Napol 'Joe' Jantraget (formerly of one-star 80/20) with executive pastry chef Saki Hoshino - 'Nawa' is Thai for innovation. Modern techniques applied to central-Thai recipes; the tasting menu rotates twice a year. Located on the 1st floor of Park Lane, Ekkamai.

name: Nusara
zone: Tha Tien / Rattanakosin (336 Maha Rat Rd, opposite Wat Pho)
priceTHB: 12-course tasting menu ~฿5,990++ per person (recent Wongnai diner reviews); private room minimum spend ฿60,000++; corkage ฿2,000++/bottle
hours: Dinner only, roughly 18:00-23:00 with last seating/order 20:30; closed Tue (per recent listings) - confirm day off when booking
bookingMethod: TableCheck (100% prepaid)
bookingNotes: 100% deposit charged at booking and it is non-refundable; date changes must be made 7+ business days ahead and even eligible refunds return only 80%. Book weeks ahead - it is No. 5 on Asia's 50 Best 2026. Contact: nusarabkk@gmail.com, +66 97 293 5549.
queueTips: No walk-ins. No parking or valet at the restaurant - use Wat Pho or Royal Thai Navy Club public parking, or arrive via MRT Sanam Chai. Dinner runs about 2.5 hours; ask for an upper-floor table for the lit Wat Pho view.
dressCode: Smart casual - no flip-flops or tank tops (official policy)
signature: 12-course 'Colorful Thai Cuisine' tasting menu
Blue swimming crab curry with crispy rice noodles
Grilled river prawn with shrimp-paste relish
facts: Opened 2020 by chef Thitid 'Ton' Tassanakajohn (of Le Du) and his brother Chaisiri 'Tam', named for their grandmother Nusara. One MICHELIN star (Thailand 2026), No. 5 on Asia's 50 Best Restaurants 2026 and No. 35 on The World's 50 Best 2025; the dining rooms on the upper floors look straight onto Wat Pho. Chef Ton calls the style 'Colorful Thai Cuisine'.

name: Potong
zone: เยาวราช (สำเพ็ง/ทรงวาด)
station: MRT วัดมังกร
priceTHB: เทสติ้งเมนู "5 senses, 5 elements" 6,300++ ต่อคน (ปรับเป็น 6,700++ ตั้งแต่ 1 ส.ค. 2026) ไม่รวม VAT 7% + เซอร์วิส 10%
hours: เปิดทุกวันยกเว้นพุธ 15:30–23:00 (รอบที่นั่งแรก 15:30 รอบสุดท้าย 20:30 ใช้เวลา 2.5–3 ชม.)
bookingMethod: เว็บทางการ (ระบบ Chope)
bookingNotes: มัดจำ 1,000 บาท/คน หักจากบิลจริง เลื่อนได้ถึง 48 ชม.ก่อนถึงวันจอง (มัดจำไม่คืนถ้ายกเลิก/ไม่มา); จองผ่าน Chope ได้เช่นกัน (chope.co/bangkok-restaurants/restaurant/restaurant-potong)
queueTips: ไม่มีคิวหน้าร้าน — จองล่วงหน้าอย่างเดียว ที่นั่งเต็มเร็วหลังรีโนเวตเปิดใหม่ 16 มิ.ย. 2026; มีชัตเทิลจากลานจอดรถวัดปทุมคงคา
facts: เชฟแพม–พิชญา สุนทรญาณกิจ เปิดร้านปี 2021 ในตึกชิโน-โปรตุกีสอายุกว่า 100 ปีที่เคยเป็นร้านขายยาของครอบครัวเธอในเยาวราช; ได้ 1 ดาวมิชลินพร้อมรางวัล Opening of the Year ปี 2023 และรักษาดาวต่อเนื่องถึงไกด์ 2026; เชฟแพมได้ Asia's Best Female Chef 2024 และ The World's Best Female Chef 2025 (คนไทยคนแรก); ร้านติดอันดับ 13 ของ The World's 50 Best Restaurants 2025; มิชลินยกให้เป็นไฟน์ไดนิงไทย-จีนที่ "ดั้งเดิมและแปลกใหม่มาบรรจบกัน"; รีโนเวตใหญ่และเปิดใหม่ 16 มิ.ย. 2026 พร้อมเมนูชุดใหม่

name: Resonance
zone: สุขุมวิท 65 (พระโขนง–เอกมัย)
bookingMethod: Chope

queueTips: ร้านเล็ก ที่นั่งจำกัด — จองล่วงหน้าอย่างน้อย 1–2 สัปดาห์ โดยเฉพาะรอบศุกร์–เสาร์
facts: เชฟชุนสุเกะ ชิโมมูระ (Shunsuke Shimomura) ชาวญี่ปุ่น เจ้าของคอนเซ็ปต์ "Boundless Cuisine" — เมนูเล่าเส้นทางการทำงานทั่วโลกของเชฟผสานรากญี่ปุ่น; ได้ 1 ดาวมิชลินตั้งแต่ไกด์ 2024 และรักษาดาวปี 2025–2026; มิชลินชมซุปหอยลาย ผักย่างตามฤดู แลมบ์ช็อป และแกงกะหรี่เนื้อ พร้อมไวน์ลิสต์เน้นเบอร์กันดี; ตั้งอยู่ในซอยสุขุมวิท 65

name: Elements, Inspired by Ciel Bleu
zone: ชั้น 25 โรงแรม The Okura Prestige Bangkok, ถนนวิทยุ เพลินจิต
station: BTS Phloen Chit (สกายวอล์กเชื่อมโรงแรม)
priceTHB: เทสติ้งเมนู 3 ระดับ Ku-Ki (4 คอร์ส) / Chikyu (6 คอร์ส) / Mizu (8 คอร์ส); แพ็กเกจ Hungry Hub ฿3,000 / ฿4,900 / ฿7,300 net ต่อคน
hours: พุธ–อาทิตย์ ดินเนอร์ 18:00–22:30 (last order 21:30; ปิดจันทร์–อังคาร)
bookingMethod: TableCheck ของโรงแรม, Chope หรือ Hungry Hub (แพ็กเกจลดราคา); โทร 02-687-9000
bookingNotes: จองผ่านเว็บโรงแรมให้เผื่อยืนยัน 24 ชม.; Hungry Hub มักถูกกว่าราคาหน้าเมนู; Chope ก็รับจอง (chope.co/bangkok-restaurants/restaurant/elements-bkk)
queueTips: ขอโต๊ะริมกระจกชมวิวเส้นขอบฟ้ากรุงเทพฯ ชั้น 25; ที่นั่งจำกัดเพราะห้องอาหารเล็ก จองล่วงหน้าช่วงสุดสัปดาห์
signature: เมนูฝรั่งเศสผสานวัตถุดิบญี่ปุ่นตามฤดูกาล
เทสติ้งเมนู Ku-Ki / Chikyu / Mizu เลือกจานหลัก-ของหวานเองได้
ครัวเปิดผนังชาร์โคล
facts: ห้องอาหาร 1 ดาวมิชลิน (ไกด์ไทยแลนด์ 2026) บนชั้น 25 ของโรงแรม The Okura Prestige ทำงานร่วมกับ Ciel Bleu ร้าน 2 ดาวของโรงแรมโอกุระ อัมสเตอร์ดัม เสิร์ฟฝรั่งเศสร่วมสมัยกลิ่นอายญี่ปุ่น นำครัวโดยเชฟเฌราร์ วิยาเรต์ ออร์กาโฆ (ตามข้อมูล Chope)

name: Haoma
zone: สุขุมวิท ซอย 31 (พร้อมพงษ์/วัฒนา)
priceTHB: ดินเนอร์เทสติ้ง 10 คอร์ส ฿4,990++/คน (เลือก meat&seafood หรือมังสวิรัติ); ลันช์เสาร์-อาทิตย์ 6 คอร์ส ฿3,290++; เครื่องดื่มแพริ่งเริ่ม ฿3,290++; pre-authorization ฿500/คน
bookingMethod: Chope (จองออนไลน์สด), เว็บร้าน haoma.dk, อีเมล reservations@haoma.dk หรือ Line @haomabkk
bookingNotes: Chope ใช้ pre-auth บัตร ฿500/คน; แจ้งข้อจำกัดอาหารล่วงหน้าได้ (มีเมนูมังสวิรัติเต็มรูปแบบ); โทร +66 92 891 8222
queueTips: ร้านอยู่ลึกในซอยสุขุมวิท 31 — จาก BTS พร้อมพงษ์เดินราว 15 นาที นั่งวินหรือแท็กซี่เข้าซอยสะดวกกว่า
signature: เทสติ้งเมนู Neo-Indian ตามฤดูกาล (มีเวอร์ชันมังสวิรัติ)
ผัก-สมุนไพรจากฟาร์มในร้านและปลาจากระบบอควาโปนิกส์
เมนูเล่าเรื่องภูมิภาคต่าง ๆ ของอินเดีย
facts: ร้าน 1 ดาวมิชลินพ่วงดาวเขียว (Green Star) ของเชฟดีปังเกอร์ โคสลา ชูปรัชญา 'We grow what we cook, we cook what we love' — เป็น urban farm & zero-waste restaurant แห่งแรก ๆ ของไทย เก็บน้ำฝนเลี้ยงระบบอควาโปนิกส์ ปลูกพืชในร้าน และมีฟาร์มเลี้ยงไก่ แพะ วัว ของตัวเองในกรุงเทพฯ

name: Igniv
zone: Ratchaprasong / Ratchadamri (Pathum Wan)
priceTHB: Dinner sharing tasting menu ฿5,500++/person (Summer 2026 menu); wine pairing ฿3,500–4,500++; Lunch Break Mon–Fri from ฿1,600++ (2 dishes) to ฿2,300++ (4 dishes); weekend brunch ฿3,200++
hours: Lunch Mon–Fri 12:00–15:00 (LO 13:30); brunch Sat–Sun 11:00–15:00 (LO 13:30); dinner daily 18:00–23:00 (LO 20:30)
bookingMethod: Online via SevenRooms (official site 'Reserve' button), or phone +66 2 207 7822 / email igniv.bangkok@stregis.com
bookingNotes: Books via the St. Regis SevenRooms system; for groups/private dining contact the restaurant directly. Prices are ++ (add 10% service + 7% VAT).
queueTips: Reservation essentially required; dinner last order is early (20:30), so book an early slot. Ground floor of The St. Regis Bangkok, reached via the hotel's private skybridge from BTS Ratchadamri.
dressCode: Smart casual — for men no shorts, sport pants or open shoes
signature: Sharing-style tasting menu of 17–19 small dishes served to the table
Kitchen-counter welcome snacks
The Candy Store dessert finale
facts: First branch of Swiss 3-star chef Andreas Caminada's IGNIV 'nest' sharing concept outside Switzerland, inside The St. Regis Bangkok (159 Rajadamri Rd). Earned its Michelin star in the Thailand 2022 guide and retains it in 2026; inspectors praise dishes 'executed with a Swiss clock-making precision'. Head chef Arne Riehn (per official Instagram bio).

name: Ann Tha Din Daeng
zone: Khlong San / Tha Din Daeng (Thonburi 'Little China Town')
priceTHB: Roughly ฿300–800/head (Wongnai band ฿501–1,000); famous fried river prawn with salt ฿450 per prawn; simpler dishes from ~฿100
hours: Wed–Sun 11:00–20:00 (Google lists 10:30 open); closed Mon–Tue
bookingMethod: Walk-in or phone +66 81 695 0597 — restaurant manages its own reservations (no online platform)
bookingNotes: Cash only (per Michelin Guide). No booking platform; call ahead in Thai if possible.
queueTips: Popular dishes sell out — arrive early in the day; reviewers note it can close early once seafood runs out. Turnover is fast (many takeaway orders).
signature: Fried river prawn with salt (กุ้งแม่น้ำทอดเกลือ)
Stir-fried prawns with salt and pepper (กุ้งทอดเกลือ)
Clams with sweet chilli paste and Thai basil (หอยลายผัดพริกเผา)
Crab meat in yellow chilli curry (เนื้อปูผัดพริกเหลือง)
facts: Family-run seafood shophouse at 167 Tha Din Daeng Rd, Khlong San, operating for over twenty years in Thonburi's 'Little China Town' (Michelin's words). Bib Gourmand in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Thailand; inspectors single out the stir-fried salt-and-pepper prawns and clams with sweet chilli paste and Thai basil.

name: Aunglo by Yangrak
zone: Silom / Bang Rak (Decho Road)
priceTHB: Michelin ฿฿ (moderate); skewers/small plates roughly ฿40–200 per dish per pre-move reviews — order several to share
hours: 11:30–14:30 & 17:00–22:00 (last order 14:00 / 21:00); closed Tuesdays (per official Instagram bio)
bookingMethod: Online via TableCheck, or phone +66 98 965 5996
bookingNotes: TableCheck opens 30 days ahead; 2-hour dining slots; counter bar limited to groups of 1–4; groups of 6+ pay a ฿300/person deposit (non-refundable within 24h or no-show). 10% service + 7% VAT added.
queueTips: Book ahead — lunch fills and dinner usually has a wait for walk-ins. Arrive no later than 30 minutes after your booking time or the table is released.
signature: Charcoal-grilled skewers from the traditional aunglo brazier
Grilled Thai rice bowls with catch of the day
Pork belly with Pattani salt
Coconut pancake with southern curry shrimp
facts: Young-team Thai-Chinese 'Thai izakaya' where nearly everything is grilled over a traditional aunglo charcoal brazier; counter seats face the grill station. Bib Gourmand holder (first awarded 2023 guide, retained in 2026). Moved to a refreshed, larger space at 174/4-6 Decho Rd in 2025 after three years at its first location on the same street — Michelin's 2026 entry reviews the new site.

name: Baan Pee Lek
zone: Prawet / Nong Bon (Chaloem Phrakiat Rama 9)
priceTHB: Dishes ~฿120–400; typical spend ฿250–1,000/head depending on group size
hours: Mon–Thu 11:00–14:00 & 16:30–22:30; Fri–Sun 11:00–22:30 (sources disagree — call to confirm)
bookingMethod: Phone only: 02-393-8839 / 02-398-3010 (mobile 091-444-7964 also listed) — restaurant manages its own bookings; staff may add you on LINE to pre-order
bookingNotes: Regulars call ahead to reserve AND pre-order dishes via LINE so food arrives quickly; Mastercard/Visa accepted, has parking.
queueTips: Since the Michelin listing it draws queues at peak meal times — pre-ordering by phone/LINE avoids an hour-plus wait for cooked-to-order dishes.
signature: Dry massaman with pork ribs (มัสมั่นแห้งซี่โครงหมู)
Stir-fried ginger (ผัดพริกขิง)
Minced pork with salted fish (หมูสับปลาเค็ม)
Scrambled egg 'khai kuan' (ไข่กวน)
facts: Home-style house restaurant (39 Soi Chaloem Phrakiat Rama 9 Soi 9, Nong Bon, Prawet) run for over 30 years by 'Pee Lek' and his wife, furnished with antique wooden decor. Michelin's 2026 Bib Gourmand entry cites Northern and Central Thai dishes honouring the owners' birthplaces in Chiang Mai and Bangkok; OpenRice records Bib Gourmand recognition 2023–2026.

name: Beer Hima (Chatuchak)
zone: Chatuchak / Prachachuen (Thetsaban Songkhro Rd)
priceTHB: ~฿500–1,000/head typical (Wongnai band); fresh seafood priced by weight can push a large group's bill into the thousands
bookingMethod: Phone: 02-954-3404 / 02-954-3405 — restaurant manages its own bookings; walk-ins common
bookingNotes: Private room seats up to 30; has its own car park; UnionPay/JCB/Mastercard/Visa accepted.
queueTips: Large multi-room seafood 'empire' so waits are rare outside big weekend dinners; go early evening for the best pick from the live-seafood tanks.
signature: Southern sour curry with grouper (แกงเหลืองปลาเก๋า)
Stir-fried prawns with shrimp paste and bitter beans (กุ้งผัดสะตอกะปิ)
Turmeric-fried sillago fish (ปลาเห็ดโคนทอดขมิ้น)
Semi-frozen 'snow beer' slushy
facts: Family-run Southern Thai seafood institution in Chatuchak, cooking Nakhon Si Thammarat recipes for over 30 years; the name means 'snow beer', after its signature semi-frozen beer. Michelin's Bib Gourmand entry (branch listed as Chatuchak, formerly Prachachuen) praises the turmeric-and-chilli-packed southern sour curry with grouper; Michelin's own feature notes seven consecutive Bib years (2019–2025), and it stays in the 2026 selection.

name: Bokkia Tha Din Daeng (โบ๊กเกี้ย ท่าดินแดง)

queueTips: คิวยาวช่วงเย็นวันร้อนๆ แต่หมุนเร็วเพราะส่วนใหญ่ซื้อกลับ; ไปช่วงเปิดร้านใหม่ๆ (~15:00) คิวสั้นสุด
signature: โบ๊กเกี้ยรวมเครื่อง (35/45 บาท) — เส้นบะหมี่หวานราดน้ำเชื่อม โปะน้ำแข็งเกล็ด
เครื่องให้เลือก: เผือกเชื่อม แปะก๊วย ถั่วแดง ข้าวโพด ลูกชิด เฉาก๊วย ขนุน
หมี่เย็น (~24 บาท)

name: Bunloet / บุญเลิศ บะหมี่เกี๊ยวหมูย่างซีอิ๊ว (ป้อมปราบศัตรูพ่าย)

priceTHB: จานละ 40-95 บาท (บะหมี่เกี๊ยวหมูย่าง 60-80, ปีกไก่ตุ๋น 80); ต่อหัวต่ำกว่า 100

signature: บะหมี่เกี๊ยวหมูย่างซีอิ๊ว (เมนูลายเซ็น — หมูสันไหล่หมักซีอิ๊ว น้ำตาล พริกไทย ย่างเตาถ่าน)
ข้าวหมูแดง-หมูกรอบ

name: Gim Nguan Noodle (กิมง้วนลูกชิ้นปลา)

priceTHB: ชามละ 59-90 บาท (เส้นเล็กต้มยำ 65, ต้มยำน้ำข้น 90); เรือลูกชิ้นรวมลวกจิ้ม 200; ต่อหัว 101-250

priceTHB: ต่อหัว ~251-500 บาท; ข้าวผัดโคตรปูจานละ ~480-510 บาท (เมนู Wongnai ล่าสุด; บทความปีก่อนๆ เริ่ม 340 — ราคาขยับขึ้น), โคตรกั้งกระเทียม 565, โคตรหอยเชลล์กะเพรา 385
bookingMethod: walk-in / ต่อคิวหน้าร้าน (ไม่รับจองโต๊ะ)

Matsuri Gozen special set

Sources produce from local farmers.

facts: Bib Gourmand in the MICHELIN Guide Thailand 2025 and 2026. Michelin's inspectors describe a no-frills kitchen in a wooden house that has been serving intensely flavourful Thai fare 'for over 120 years', singling out the fish cake made from real spotted featherback fish with the sweet house-special sauce. The family says the business spans more than five generations; the dining room is an old wooden house with plank floors on the Rangsit–Nakhon Nayok road.

Michelin flags the signature mud-crab coconut dip (lon pu) as a must-order. Wongnai reviews run through October 2025.
